text: 狼獾的爪牙撕咬着伯纳德的身体。他痛苦的叫声令你心如刀割。人和野兽在地上扭打时，你朝那团笨重的身体开了一枪，但伤害已经造成。
你必须决定，是为了纪念伯纳德而继续探险，还是因为这场悲剧折返。其他学生都望着你，等你带领大家。
若要继续，前往 75。若你已心灰意冷，前往 54。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 94
text: The wolverine’s claws and teeth rip into Bernard’s body. His anguished cry tears at your heart. As man and beast wrestle on the earth, you put a slug into the animal’s lumpish body. But the damage is done.
You must decide whether to honor Bernard by continuing the expedition—or to turn back because of this tragedy. The other students look to you for leadership.
To continue, go to 75. If you are discouraged, go to 54.
